_doc: Fixed closed-loop evaluation of the downstream line (decision D6): the 34 seen target tasks (18 atomic_seen + 16 composite_seen) x 20 episodes = 680 episodes, target kitchens, task-specific horizons of RoboCasa 1.0.1, one policy call per 16-step chunk. Evaluation seeds are separate from training seeds (training uses the experiment's seed: 1, 2, 3).
